decisions.reason: After several years without visible signs of traction, an audio and web conferencing offer looks less differentiated from powerful platform competitors and falls short of the firm's infrastructure-led strategic focus, so resources would likely be redeployed.

This metropolitan data centre connectivity service remains tightly aligned with the firm's core network and data-centre capabilities, and its earlier adoption suggests performance at least near aspiration despite lower later visibility.

Optical spectrum connectivity fits the firm's owned fibre assets and move toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure, so a large expanding firm would usually continue it unless clear failure appears.

Although it is not highly visible, the voice number ordering portal supports automation and real-time provisioning in the existing customer base, and with slack the firm is likely to retain such a complementary capability a bit longer.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony service with weak fit to the firm's forward direction, so prolonged uncertainty would place it below aspiration and make withdrawal very likely.
